question: When was the All India Tennis Association (AITA) established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1920.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** All India Tennis Association** (AITA) is the governing body of tennis in India.
 
• AITA was established in **1920 **and is affiliated with International Tennis Federation and Asian Tennis Federation.
 
• All India Tennis Association operates all of the Indian national representative tennis sides, including the **India Davis Cup team, the India Billie Jean King Cup team **and youth sides as well.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ITF: **International Tennis Federation** is the highest governing body of lawn tennis.

 
 
• Length of the Tennis Court**-78 feet.**
 
• The first **U.S. Championship was organized in 1968.**
 
• The first **French Open was organized in 1891**.
 
• **Australian, French, Wimbledon, US Open, and Grand Slams** are held every year.
 
• **Ghaus Mohammad** was the first Indian to reach the quarterfinals at Wimbledon in 1939.
 
• **1996, Leander Paes **made history by becoming the first Indian to win an individual Olympic medal in tennis.
 
• Important tennis players of India-**Sania Mirja, Mahesh Bhupathi, lender Paes, Rohan Bopanna, Somdev Devvarman**, etc.
